title: SB 658 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to voter identification.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1, 2-7-112(c)(2) (new)
(quote) "Evidence of identification," as described in subdivision (c)(1), does not include a license, identification card, passport, or other document that has expired or that is invalid for any reason.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 2 (new section, Title 2, ch. 2, pt. 1)
(quote) Notwithstanding a law to the contrary, a county election commission shall not register a person to vote unless the applicant has provided proof satisfactory to the respective commission that the person holds valid, unexpired evidence of identification as described in § 2-7-112(c)(1) at the time of processing the applicant's application to register.
(other) Sec. 1 also designates the existing 2-7-112(c) as (c)(1).
(other) Sec. 3: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 3094744-Draft (only saved version): slot a (expired or invalid ID is not 'evidence of identification') and slot e (no registration without valid, unexpired ID). Slots b-d not stated.
(other) note: Draft text only; no votes. Caption names House companion HB0574. The registration clause is tied to the (c)(1) item, the Tennessee driver licence.
